spec.rationale: V243 shared coverage-only augmentation lowered KS to0.52934705 and AUC to0.84692008, although counts have strong marginal risk associations. V25 already includes observation depth and posterior uncertainty. Preserve its learned correction; test residual information without refitting its90 coefficients. V251 is the matched support control, V252 adds value information, V253 diagnoses the projection choice. Coefficients use the same6k as the original head, so training optimism and repeated development selection remain; no improvement is assumed.
